selection_reasoning: I selected these 4 tasks to create a multi-hop dependency structure. The crafting tasks require specific materials that can be partially obtained through mining tasks. Here's the logic: (1) 'mine purple_stained_glass_pane' provides glass panes which, while not directly used in crafting magenta_wool, establishes a spatial prerequisite — the player must navigate past or through a glass structure to reach the crafting area. (2) 'mine fern' is a gathering task that requires shears or silk touch, but more importantly it gates access to materials needed later. (3) 'craft to magenta_wool' requires white wool + magenta dye at a crafting table — this depends on the player first clearing the fern area to access sheep/wool and finding dye materials. (4) 'craft to lapis_block' requires 9 lapis lazuli combined at a crafting table — this is the final task that depends on having cleared the glass pane barrier to access the lapis lazuli storage. The dependency chain creates a branching structure where two mining tasks feed into two crafting tasks.

milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining fern with shears drops the fern item into the player's inventory. The player has shears equipped and must break at least one of the 3 ferns in the side corridor (at spawn-relative positions (-7,0,-1), (-7,0,0), (-7,0,1)) to clear the path to the wool/dye chest. Shears guarantee the fern drops as an item.

Uses count_in_box_at_most (kind=block, max_count=19) because purple stained glass panes do NOT drop an item when broken without Silk Touch (player only has shears). The barrier was placed with /fill from (-2,0,5) to (2,3,5) creating 5 wide x 4 tall = 20 pane blocks. Checking that at most 19 remain means at least one was mined. The box exactly covers the barrier wall location.

Uses inventory_has because crafting magenta wool (1 white wool + 1 magenta dye, shapeless recipe at crafting table) produces magenta_wool which ends up in the player's inventory. The materials come from the chest at (-8,0,0) behind the ferns in the side corridor. Magenta wool is not present in the starting inventory.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a lapis block (9 lapis lazuli in 3x3 grid at crafting table) produces lapis_block which ends up in the player's inventory. The 9 lapis lazuli come from the chest at (0,0,8) behind the purple stained glass pane barrier. Lapis block is not present in the starting inventory.

scene_description: A large stone brick room with glass ceiling and glowstone lighting. A purple stained glass pane wall blocks access to a back room containing a chest with 9 lapis lazuli. A side corridor to the left has ferns growing on grass blocks that block access to a chest containing white wool and magenta dye. A crafting table is accessible in the main room. Player starts with shears for mining ferns.
task_text: Mine the ferns blocking the left corridor to access wool and dye materials. Break through the purple stained glass pane barrier to reach the lapis lazuli. Use the crafting table to craft magenta wool, then craft a lapis block.
design_notes: Player spawns in center of room facing the purple glass pane barrier. Crafting table at (2,0,3). Fern corridor entrance at x=-6 with 3 ferns at x=-7. Wool/dye chest at (-8,0,0). Lapis chest at (0,0,8) behind glass barrier. The glass pane barrier spans from (-2,0,5) to (2,3,5) = 5 wide x 4 tall = 20 pane blocks. Ferns placed on grass_block at y=-1.
